Fortress 2.5Ltr Graphite Anti-Slip Decking Stain is a water-based solution meticulously designed to protect and enhance outdoor timber decking. Its anti-slip properties provide added safety for areas where secure footing is paramount, while the deep graphite colour offers a modern and durable finish. This resilient decking stain is ideal for outdoor timber surfaces, such as garden decks and patio areas, requiring long-lasting protection. The quick-drying formula is touch-dry in two hours and recoatable in four, allowing for efficient project completion. It creates a robust barrier, resisting both water and UV damage, ensuring the decking remains nourished and protected against the elements for extended periods.
